title: A$AP Rocky Brings Trippy ‘Shroom Clouds’ to Streaming Services for the First Time: Listen
summary: "Shroom Clouds" serves as the lead single for Don't Be Dumb - Disc 2.
contentText:
A$AP Rocky’s Don’t Be Dumb – Disc 2 is finally on the way. The Harlem rapper set the deluxe project’s rollout in motion with the release of its lead single “Shroom Clouds,” which hit streaming services for the first time on Friday (Oct. 16).

Related

A$AP Rocky Announces First Australian and New Zealand Tour in Eight Years

Rihanna Hints at Wanting Baby No. 4 With A$AP Rocky in 2026: ‘So I’m Not Crazy Then?’

Fans of the Mob frontman might be familiar with “Shroom Clouds,” which was previously titled “Mushroom Clouds” and saw Rocky perform it live at a 420 Weedmaps event and Governors Ball in 2021, as well as during his Amazon Music Live set in 2022.

A$AP Mob’s Hector Delgado helms the trippy production, while Rocky delivers a catchy chorus. “Super stoned, super high/ March, April, May, shroom, July/ Super stoned, super high/ See mushroom clouds in the sky,” he raps.

Speaking to Billboard earlier this week, Rocky confirmed that Disc 2 is on the horizon and detailed what songs will be making the cut while teasing the “next chapter” of his career.

“This music video — I don’t know if you remember that — was a fan favorite. I performed it a few times, but now we gonna re-release it,” he said. “ Disc 2  is all of the songs that I dropped that those alter egos didn’t get an album to live on, because the next chapter is right after that.”

Rocky’s Don’t Be Dumb arrived in January and served as his first LP since 2018’s TESTING . The experimental album debuted atop the Billboard 200 with 123,000 total album-equivalent units earned, which marked his first No. 1 in over a decade.

After wrapping up his European trek, the 38-year-old will be bringing the Don’t Be Dumb World Tour to five arenas across Australia and New Zealand this December. General tickets will be on sale on Friday at 1 p.m. local time.
